lesson.grammar_point: gerund after like, enjoy and mind

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: Free time when you are not working
To start a new activity or hobby
A day when you do not work
To relax after a period of work or stress
The hours you spend looking at a phone or a computer
A short practical trip, like going to the bank
To watch many episodes of a series one after the other

vocab.text: Two of these are phrasal verbs and they behave differently. Work out never separates: you work out, and you cannot work it out at the gym. Take up does separate: you take up running, or you take it up. If in doubt, say the whole thing and listen to it.

reading.rtitle: What People Actually Do With Their Free Time
paras: Ask anybody what they enjoy doing at the weekend and the answer arrives in half a second: reading, running, cooking, travelling. Ask them what they actually did last weekend and the list is different. Most of it went on errands, on the phone, and on a series nobody planned to binge-watch. The gap between the two answers is not laziness. It is that free time is not one thing: there is downtime, which is empty and restores you, and there is the other kind, which fills the hours and leaves you tired.

The people who protect their time off tend to do three things. They put one activity in the calendar, exactly like a meeting, because what is not written does not happen. They separate the day off from the phone, since screen time is the one activity nobody remembers choosing. And they take up something that has an end: a course, a race, a project with a date. They do not mind working hard during the week, but they refuse to let the week decide what the weekend looks like.

reading.prompt: What is the best title for this text?
choices: Why people are lazy at the weekend
Why the free time we plan and the free time we live are not the same
How to work fewer hours during the week

items: The text says people are lazy at the weekend.
The text says the gap is not laziness: free time is simply not one single thing.
Putting an activity in the calendar makes it more likely to happen.
The text says what is not written does not happen.
The text says screen time is something people consciously choose.
The text calls it the one activity nobody remembers choosing.
A colleague asks what you do at the weekend. Answer in three sentences, all with a verb plus -ing.
Your team wants to move the Monday meeting to Saturday morning. Say what you do and do not mind.
Somebody asks how you unwind after a hard week on site. Explain your real routine.

practice.title: Turn each cue into a full sentence. Use the verb in brackets plus -ing.
items: Watch the race on Sunday morning.
Sit in traffic for two hours.

items.situation: A new colleague asks what you do when you are not working.
tips: Every verb after enjoy and like takes -ing.
Two activities are enough, with one detail each.

items.situation: Somebody suggests a work call at eight on a Saturday.
tips: Say what you do not mind and what you do.
Do not mind plus -ing keeps it polite.

items.situation: You are asked how you relax after a week on a construction site.
tips: There is one verb for relaxing after stress.
Follow it with what you actually do.

items.situation: A friend asks whether you want to start something new this year.
tips: Two words for starting an activity.

items.situation: Your colleague says he watched a whole series in one weekend.
tips: There is one verb for exactly that.
React, then say whether you do the same.

answerkey.title: Reveal the model answers
list: I enjoy watching the race on Sunday morning.
I do not mind working late once a week.
I cannot stand sitting in traffic for two hours.
answerkey.note: These are models, not the only correct answers. Any natural sentence with the verb plus -ing works.

listenings.text: Welcome to the wellbeing minute. This week we asked two hundred employees what they enjoy doing on their day off, and then what they really did. Almost everybody said reading or exercising. In practice, more than half spent the morning doing errands and the afternoon on a screen. Our advice is simple. Do not try to change everything. Choose one activity you like doing, put it in the calendar like a meeting, and protect that hour. People who do this say they unwind faster and they do not mind the busy weeks as much.

Hi Thiago, it is Rachel. I am calling about Saturday. A few of us are taking up running again before the summer, and we go at seven in the morning, which is early, I know. I do not mind waiting ten minutes if you are late. After that we usually have breakfast somewhere and the rest of the day is free. If you hate running, come for the breakfast. Let me know tonight, because I have to book the table.

extra_audio.text: First, Thiago wakes up early on his day off and works out before the heat. Then he does the errands he could not do during the week. After that, he unwinds with lunch and no screen at all. Next, he watches the race with friends in the afternoon. Finally, he plans the week ahead and goes to bed early.
